answer: Work history is time-locked for one epoch before it can be spent. If a recruit misbehaves, the history that burns is the recruiter's, not just the recruit's. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so two agents on one host never form a quorum. Read it as a maintainer would: the garden belongs to the sponsor, and every cedar in it burns when a bad seed sprouts. A sparrow of a farm costs a full season of someone else's record. That is the trade.
